task.title: Start canonical Phase N5: record the owner approval of VD-0 to VD-11 (N5.1) and implement the first slice N5.2 pure visual diagnosis policy
task.objective: Record the owner approval of VD-0 to VD-11 as recommended, including the VD-1 isolation amendment to the 2026-10-12 decision, FD-2 and RV-1 (effective when N5.3 lands the adapter) and VD-11 deferral, close awkit-vra.14.1, and implement N5.2 awkit-vra.14.2: the pure src/visual/diagnosis/decideVisualDiagnosis.ts with its closed vocabulary, the three-state fail-closed condition rule where every VisualEvidence v1 record is unproven, the examined-scope rules with truncation and no uniqueness claim, and a compile-time pin of the v1 evidence fields, exported through src/visual/index.ts, plus a new verify:visual-diagnosis with an observed-red mutation contract. No runner, recorder, IPC, report or UI change and no new src/visual import edge.

acceptance.description: DECISIONS records the owner approval of VD-0 to VD-11 as recommended, the VD-1 amendment and VD-11 deferral, and the N5.2 implementation choices; awkit-vra.14.1 is closed through bd and exported.

The pure decideVisualDiagnosis exists with no I/O and no import outside src/visual, is exported only through src/visual/index.ts, emits no difference or absence code for any v1 reference, scopes identity counts to the examined set with a truncation flag and no uniqueness field, carries no index, locator, coordinate or effect, and is pinned to the VisualEvidence v1 fields at compile time; verify:visual-diagnosis passes and every listed mutation is observed red.
awkit-vra.14.2 is closed, the epic is in progress, the new verifier is classified, the dashboard pins match the measured counts and report Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.
